_comment: WORLD DESIGN DATA (Hub Design 3.0) for the first Wonderland Hub, kept separate from the generator so artists/assets swap without touching systems. Composed per docs/relay/WONDERLAND_ART_DIRECTION.md + docs/relay/WONDERLAND_VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE.md and documented in docs/relay/wonderland/HUB_DESIGN.md.
_status: AUTHORED / SPECIFIED, NOT RENDERED and NOT COMPILED. No Unreal Engine exists in this environment (2-core Chromebook, no GPU). There is no .umap, no lighting, no materials, no foliage, no frame. Every dimension, elevation, count and radius below is DESIGN INTENT for whoever builds the level and its assets — a target, never a measurement. See docs/relay/wonderland/HUB_DESIGN.md 'Unproven'.
_units: Unreal world units. 1 uu = 1 cm. Positions are [x, y, z]. +Y is world-north (arrival at -Y, the distant skyline at +Y); +X is world-east; +Z is up. Ground plane is z = 0. Landmark 'location' z is the mesh PIVOT height (BasicShapes cube/cylinder/cone pivots are centred), so a ground-standing object sits at z = height/2.
_designNote: This is a TIGHT, DENSE vertical slice, not a large world. The walkable footprint is deliberately smaller than a sprawling map; quality comes from composition density and sight-lines, not acreage. Distant silhouettes sit OUTSIDE the nav bounds as pure background.

atmosphere._note: DESIGN INTENT targeting WONDERLAND_VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE.md §6 (sun elevation 22-38° above horizon, warm golden key ~4400-5200K) and §7 (fog density 0.015-0.040, lavender haze). sunElevationDeg is elevation ABOVE horizon; the generator negates it into a downward light pitch.
atmosphere._visualPass1: Sun raised 30 -> 52 deg and volumetric cloud enabled: the reference is a bright midday garden city, and the low golden-hour key was reading as dusk.
atmosphere._sunAzimuth: Moved 34 -> 205: the hero view looks north, so the old sun sat in frame and washed the sky to cream. Behind the camera front-lights the plaza and leaves blue sky in view.

camera._note: Third-person gameplay pawn spring-arm; matches AWonderlandDogPawn constants (WONDERLAND.md §4). The heroCameras below are separate framing cameras for reference stills, not the gameplay rig.
camera._composition: Boom 420->760uu, pitch -12->-18, socket 90->150uu: the short boom framed the Dog against whatever prop happened to be behind it.

heroCameras.name: Arrival Hero (iconic first frame)
heroCameras.note: The founder's first frame. AT z=700 LOOKING LEVEL THE GROUND IN FRONT OF THE CAMERA WAS NOT IN FRAME: the near ground sat 34 deg below a view axis with a 19 deg half-angle, so the frame only opened onto the ground about 20 m out and anything staged in the foreground was below the bottom edge, not merely small. Eye lowered to 430 and tilted ~2 deg down: ground reads from ~10 m, which is where a foreground subject can stand.
heroCameras._composition: Pulled back 1240->2450uu and raised 405->1020uu. At the old distance the foreground props were larger in frame than the castle city, which is the opposite of the reference's hierarchy.

heroCameras.name: Golden Build Gate approach
heroCameras.note: Looking west-north across Heart Plaza to the Start-Building landmark; the gate reads as the tallest warm-gold vertical on the west side.

heroCameras.name: Project Brain vista (north axis)
heroCameras.note: Straight up the main boulevard to the Brain Observatory and its reflecting pool; the deepest sight-line in the slice.

heroCameras.name: Mission Overlook panorama
heroCameras.note: From the elevated east terrace looking back across Heart Plaza toward the gate and brain; the vantage that reads the whole slice at once.

heroCameras.name: Great Framing Tree portrait
heroCameras.note: The gnarled hero tree with its oval portrait frame, canopy overhanging the Agent Garden.

heroCameras.name: Hidden Grove reveal
heroCameras.note: The reward vantage at the end of the hidden path, looking back out of the sunken grove toward the Brain — the payoff that makes exploration earn its place.

spawn._note: Player spawns in the Arrival Plaza facing world-north (+Y) so the first frame is cam_arrival_hero's composition. The Dog idles on the arcane circle at world origin.

navBounds._note: AABB of the WALKABLE volume only. Deliberately tighter than a sprawl. Distant silhouettes (below) sit outside this and are never walkable.

navBoundsPolygon._note: Tight walkable footprint (~33 m x ~32 m at widest). The east bulge (1790,1010 -> 1820,1360) is the spur to the Hidden Grove; everything beyond is background.

ground._note: Two-tone checkered flagstone, the strongest ground read in the reference. Sized to the tight footprint, not the sprawl.

hubZones.name: Arrival Plaza
hubZones.note: Where the player and Dog arrive. Quiet, legible, presents no Relay surface. Holds the survey vista and the strongest foreground flowers/petals.

hubZones.name: Heart Plaza
hubZones.note: The hub's heart: the Dog spawns here on the violet arcane circle, and the live Compound-Agent terminal reads beneath it. AgentGrounds per WonderlandHubLevel.h. Presents the 'agent' world section as a read-only terminal; it computes no substitute when that section is absent.

hubZones.name: Agent Garden
hubZones.note: A hedged garden alcove off the east trail, under the Great Framing Tree's canopy, holding the Configure-Agent pedestal. Second AgentGrounds zone: Heart Plaza is the live-terminal ground, this is the configuration garden. Raising the intent is what opens config; standing in the garden does not.

hubZones.name: Golden Build Gate Court
hubZones.note: The forecourt of the Start-Building landmark (ChaseGate kind: 'where a build begins'). The gate itself is a product landmark and must be custom Relay art. Presents no world section — Start Building is an ACTION request, gated downstream, not a status display.

hubZones.name: Mission Overlook
hubZones.note: A raised stone terrace (+120 cm, reached by 3 steps) with a balustrade over the plaza, where verified missions and their standings display read-only. Atrium kind is the nearest authoring vocabulary (read-only standings/badges); presents the 'missions' section.

hubZones.name: Active-Project Field
hubZones.note: A gently sunken field (-20 cm) west of the boulevard where active project entities stand in the form their category chose (see WONDERLAND.md §5). Presents the 'entities' section; the standing stone raises open_project.

hubZones.name: Project Brain Observatory
hubZones.note: Northern terminus of the boulevard: a luminous observatory landmark whose canopy shows the Brain's weather (sky/light/atmosphere — Observatory kind), with a reflecting pool that doubles the sky. Presents the 'brain' section; the pool rim raises open_brain.

hubZones.name: Heart Boulevard
hubZones.note: The central north-south spine connecting Arrival → Heart → Brain. Traversal only; carries no product meaning.

hubZones.name: Hidden Grove
hubZones.note: A sunken hollow (-40 cm) behind the Great Framing Tree, reached only by the concealed east path, ringed with oversized mushrooms and a secret vista back to the Brain. Streams in on approach; carries no product meaning — exploration reward only.

interactionAnchors.name: Golden Build Gate threshold
interactionAnchors.note: PROXIMITY ONLY. Standing at the threshold raises NO intent and starts NO build. An explicit interaction emits wonderland.start_building, a REQUEST; the downstream flow is gated (requiresControl=true) so the shell can prompt for a control session rather than fail. Relay decides.

interactionAnchors.name: Agent Garden configuration pedestal
interactionAnchors.note: PROXIMITY ONLY. An explicit interaction emits wonderland.configure_agent, which opens the EXISTING Configure Compound PSP Agent surface through Relay's own routes. Walking near it does nothing.

interactionAnchors.name: Mission Overlook balustrade
interactionAnchors.note: PROXIMITY ONLY. An explicit interaction emits wonderland.open_missions, opening the existing Missions surface. Proximity raises nothing.

interactionAnchors.name: Active-Project standing stone
interactionAnchors.note: PROXIMITY ONLY. An explicit interaction emits wonderland.open_project, opening the existing Project surface. Proximity raises nothing.

interactionAnchors.name: Project Brain reflecting-pool rim
interactionAnchors.note: PROXIMITY ONLY. An explicit interaction emits wonderland.open_brain, opening the existing Project Brain surface. Proximity raises nothing.

interactionAnchors.name: Arrival Overlook
interactionAnchors.note: A survey point, not an interaction. Raises NO intent by design; it exists so the first thing the player does is read the whole slice.

landmarks.name: Golden Build Gate
landmarks.note: The Start-Building product landmark: ornate heart-finialed ivy gate, ~6.4 m tall, left repoussoir of the arrival frame. Custom Relay art (identity-critical). Frames the left edge per WONDERLAND_VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE.md §3.

landmarks.name: Great Framing Tree
landmarks.note: The huge gnarled hero tree carrying the oval portrait frame; right repoussoir, canopy overhanging the Agent Garden. Trunk blocks; canopy overlaps. Frames the right edge per §3. This is the 'giant-tree composition'.

landmarks.name: Project Brain Observatory core
landmarks.note: A luminous crystalline observatory (distinct silhouette from the tree) at the boulevard's north end; its canopy is the Brain's ambient weather. Custom Relay art. The tallest north vertical, visible from Arrival down the whole spine.

landmarks.name: Heart Topiary
landmarks.note: Heart-shaped hedge, left-inboard midground accent behind Heart Plaza.

landmarks.name: Rose Arch
landmarks.note: Rose-wrapped arch over the boulevard between Arrival and Heart Plaza; a foreground frame the player walks through, adding depth to the first shot.
landmarks._note: MOVED from y=-300: at 23 m from the hero camera the uprights blocked the sight-line they were meant to frame; at 34 m the Observatory reads through the opening.

landmarks.name: Toppled Teacup (garden)
landmarks.note: A smaller tipped cup in the Agent Garden, a rest-ledge read.

landmarks.name: Ornate Clock Tower
landmarks.note: Freestanding ornate clock behind the gate court; whimsy vertical on the west.

landmarks.name: Heart Playing-Card Signpost
landmarks.note: A heart-emblazoned card sign near the arrival split, a wayfinding read (original design, no borrowed suit iconography beyond a generic heart).
landmarks._note: MOVED off the hero Dog's stage: at [220,-520] it stood directly beside the subject in the founder's first frame.

landmarks.name: Giant Red Mushroom (arrival)
landmarks.note: Near red/white-spotted cap breaking the bottom-left of the arrival frame; foreground scale anchor.

landmarks.name: Giant Red Mushroom (garden)
landmarks.note: Largest hero cap (~4 m) in the Agent Garden; the Dog reads ~1/3 its height.

landmarks.name: Purple Mushroom Cluster (west)
landmarks.note: Mid-scale purple caps giving the west a second mushroom scale.

landmarks.name: Purple Mushroom Ring (grove)
landmarks.note: The ring of caps that marks the Hidden Grove reward.

landmarks.name: Floating Teapot
landmarks.note: Slowly drifting white teapot in the upper-mid frame; catches the warm key. Ambient drift only, no state.

landmarks.name: Agent Garden Pergola
landmarks.note: Wisteria-draped pergola sheltering the configuration pedestal; defines the garden room.

landmarks.name: Mission Overlook Terrace
landmarks.note: The raised stone platform (+120 cm top) with balustrade; blocking, with a stepped walkable edge on the boulevard side.

landmarks.name: Project Standing Stones
landmarks.note: The open_project marker: a runic standing stone in the sunken Project Field around which project entities are arranged.

landmarks.name: Oval Portrait Frame
landmarks.note: The oval frame hung in the Great Framing Tree; its contents are custom Relay art (never a borrowed likeness).

landmarks.name: Reflecting Pool Rim
landmarks.note: The ornate stone rim around the Brain's reflecting pool; walkable rim, blocking inner lip. The open_brain anchor sits on this rim.

backgroundSilhouettes.name: Castle Spire 0
backgroundSilhouettes.note: Pink/white/blue whimsical spire; haze-blended, never out-contrasts the hero.

backgroundSilhouettes.name: Floating Island (west)
backgroundSilhouettes.note: Mushroom-capped floating island, deep-background lavender silhouette.

backgroundSilhouettes.name: Distant Treeline
backgroundSilhouettes.note: A haze-toned band closing the horizon behind the spires.

roamingZones.name: Heart Plaza patrol
roamingZones.note: The hero Dog's idle patrol around the arcane circle. Wandering is AMBIENT LIFE and encodes NO Relay state (WONDERLAND_ART_DIRECTION.md §5).

roamingZones.name: Boulevard drift
roamingZones.note: Ambient skinned Dogs drift the main spine. Bounded so no Dog wanders into un-art-directed space.

roamingZones.name: Agent Garden roam
roamingZones.note: Garden Dogs among the wisteria and mushrooms.

roamingZones.name: Arrival Plaza roam
roamingZones.note: A Dog or two greeting arrival, among the foreground flowers.

foliageClusters.name: Core plaza greenery
foliageClusters.note: Grass, small plants, ground cover keeping <10% of non-path ground bare (VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE §8). DESIGN INTENT density; real scatter is M2 Editor foliage work.

foliageClusters.name: Gate court ivy & hedge
foliageClusters.note: Ivy climbing the gate, low hedges framing the court.

foliageClusters.name: Agent Garden beds
foliageClusters.note: Densest planting; wisteria, ferns, hedge walls.

foliageClusters.name: Observatory verge
foliageClusters.note: Reeds and pale blooms around the reflecting pool.

mushroomClusters.name: Arrival caps
mushroomClusters.note: Red/white foreground caps at two scales.

mushroomClusters.name: Garden caps
mushroomClusters.note: The garden's three-scale mushroom rhythm; hero cap ~4 m.

mushroomClusters.name: Grove ring
mushroomClusters.note: Purple ring around the hidden reward.

flowerBeds.name: Arrival close-focus blooms
flowerBeds.note: Foreground hero flowers; DESIGN INTENT ≥200 blooms visible in the arrival frame (VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE §8). Close-focus, may soften under subtle DoF while the Dog stays sharp.

flowerBeds.name: Boulevard verges
flowerBeds.note: Rose and wisteria along the spine.

flowerBeds.name: Pool lilies
flowerBeds.note: Floating blooms on the reflecting pool.

waterFeatures.name: Brain Reflecting Pool
earnsPlace: Doubles the Brain's ambient sky/weather read — the Observatory 'shows the sky' twice (reinforces the open_brain landmark's meaning).
A single glossy Lumen-reflection surface that showcases the AAA material/lighting target at exactly one hero location.
Bounded (~11 m across) and terminal — it closes the north axis instead of sprawling.
waterFeatures.note: The ONE water feature. It is not decorative filler: it is the mirror that makes the Brain's weather legible from the plaza. Blocking inner surface with a walkable stone rim (see brain_pool_rim). Ambient only; the reflection encodes no Relay state.

benchPoints.name: Arrival bench
benchPoints.note: Rest-and-survey seat looking north up the boulevard.

benchPoints.name: Heart Plaza bench (west)
benchPoints.note: Faces the arcane circle and the Dog.

benchPoints.name: Garden bench
benchPoints.note: Under the pergola, facing the framing tree.

benchPoints.name: Overlook bench
benchPoints.note: On the raised terrace, facing back across the plaza.

benchPoints.name: Poolside bench
benchPoints.note: Faces the reflecting pool and the Brain.

vfxAnchors.note: The violet summoning circle beneath the Dog. Time-driven ONLY; brightening on activity would be an untruthful second status channel (WONDERLAND_ART_DIRECTION.md §2).
Cross/plus glyphs rising 0.5-1.5 m and fading; spawn 1-3/s, 6-16 airborne (VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE §10). Elapsed-time driven only.
Slowly drifting gold keys, upper-right of the arrival frame.
Volumetric godray shafts in the warm key; 20-60 motes.
20-60 drifting petals over the foreground flower bed.
Soft gold shimmer around the Build Gate; ambient, NOT a build indicator.
Ambient aurora around the Observatory canopy. The Brain's REAL weather reaches the world through the projection/terminal in words — this glow is scenery, not a data channel.
Low mist over the reflecting pool.

audioZones.note: Broad bed over the whole slice.
Ambient chimes at the gate; not a build cue.
A soft distinct motif rewarding the hidden path.

main.name: Heart Boulevard
main.note: Arrival → rose arch → Heart Plaza → Brain approach. The dominant ground read; 5.5 m wide for third-person traversal.
main._note: WINDING: the five original points were collinear, which builds a runway; the eye jumps to the end of a straight path and travels along a bent one. The lateral offsets are small (<=115 uu on a 550 uu way) so the Brain still closes the axis. EXTENDED north to y=2650: the paving stopped at 1150 and left a wide band of LAWN between the plaza and the town, right across the middle of the hero frame — measured at 21.8% of it, against 1.6% for the plaza itself. The reference's middle distance is a paved way leading in, not a field.

secondary.name: Overlook steps
secondary.note: Rises 120 cm over 3 steps to the terrace.

hidden.name: Hidden Grove Path
hidden.concealment: screened by the Great Framing Tree roots and the garden hedge; entrance reads as undergrowth until approached
hidden.note: Narrow single-file trail branching off the Garden trail behind the framing tree, winding down into the sunken Hidden Grove. Streams in on approach.

sightlines.note: REQUIRED: the arrival plaza must see the Golden Build Gate. Front-left, unobstructed above the foreground flowers.
REQUIRED: the arrival plaza must see the giant tree. Front-right repoussoir.
The Brain closes the axis: visible straight up the boulevard, canopy rising above the Heart Plaza.
The Dog on the arcane circle is the eye's first destination.
The panorama vantage reads the whole slice.
Looking back south down the boulevard.
The reward vista: the grove opens onto the Brain across the pool.
